Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 14

“Actions do not stain me, nor do I long for the fruits of action. One who knows me in this way is not bound by actions.”

The verse turns doctrine into method. Krishna's freedom is not a divine exemption to admire but a model to copy — he acts without appetite for results, and so can Arjuna.
